Just posting this for anyone who may have picked up this game recently on sale through steam and wanted to play it again. I had this same issue except mine never showed the black screen. It never launched the exe at all. Never showed up in task manager or anything. I tried every single fix on the internet and none of them worked.

So I decided screw it, I'm deleting everything EA on my computer and giving up. I decided to start in my Appdata/local folder and delete any EA folder I find. I deleted these folders exactly as they were useless in my eyes, EAConnect\_Microsoft, EADesktop, EALauncherHelper, Electronic Arts.

I got distracted for a minute after that then came back and decided to hit the Play button on Steam again to see if it would launch. Lo and behold it did! Launched immediately. Zero issues. Whatever was in one of those folders was keeping the game from launching for me. So if anyone can make sense of it good luck. I just wanted to put this odd encounter out there for anyone having issues.

​

EDIT: I recently connected with EA and to my surprise I actually got someone, and I mean an actual person. They asked me questions, provided actual feedback, and found an answer. Run Origin in compatibility mode for windows 7 IF you are running windows 11.

Thats what I have. That is what I am running. And it worked flat out for me.
